title: Grouped split assignment
description: Frozen split assignment. Random image-level splits leak station, satellite, rendering, and duplicate patterns, so every split here is grouped by a natural entity boundary. Ratified 2026-08-17 by Bob (task A0): added sampling_design field (required; a stratified sample described as random is a leakage claim that will fail review); added orbital_revolution note (derived field, not present on source_observation directly); added no_station_across_splits to leakage_checks. Revised 2026-08-17 in A0b review: every leakage_checks flag is now const true, so a manifest that records a failed check is invalid by construction.

snapshot_id.description: Must match the snapshot_id in the corresponding dataset manifest.

frozen_at.description: When the split assignment was frozen. After this point the test set is never touched until final evaluation.

sampling_design.description: REQUIRED. Plain-language description of how observations were selected and stratified. A stratified sample described as random is a leakage claim that fails review. Include: time windows covered, rare client families explicitly targeted, station and transmitter reservation counts, and any known biases.

grouping_keys.description: The entity keys used to assign all observations from a given entity to one split. 'orbital_revolution' is a derived key (not present on source_observation); compute it as the integer orbital period index from TLE epoch before splitting.

splits.description: Each split type holds observation IDs in train, calibration, and test sets. Every transmitter and every orbital revolution appears in exactly one split.

train.description: Observation IDs in the training set.

calibration.description: Observation IDs in the calibration/validation set. Used for post-hoc calibration only, never for model selection.

test.description: Observation IDs in the test set. Touched exactly once, at final evaluation.

leakage_checks.description: Each flag must be asserted programmatically, not assumed. Every flag is const true, so a split manifest that records a failed check does not validate and cannot be frozen. That is deliberate: this file is the frozen artifact, produced only after the checks pass. A failing check must halt the freeze and be written up in docs/KILL_GATE.md with the measured value, never softened or dropped from this file to make it validate.

no_transmitter_across_splits.description: No transmitter_uuid appears in more than one of train, calibration, test within any split type.

no_station_across_splits.description: For cold_station and cold_combined splits: no ground_station id appears in more than one of train, calibration, test.

no_revolution_across_splits.description: No orbital revolution index appears in more than one of train, calibration, test.

no_duplicate_image_across_splits.description: No waterfall SHA-256 appears in more than one split partition. Catches exact duplicates regardless of observation id.

no_future_feature_in_train.description: No feature derived from post-observation fields, current station statistics, artifact-derived labels, or future outcomes is present in training features.

test_set_untouched.description: Test set has not been loaded, scored, or inspected outside of the single final evaluation run.
